summary.en: Rebel and SPLA-IO forces have continued lethal attacks, killing civilians in Tonj East and Warrap State, including 24 civilians with children and women, and 15 civilians in an armed assault in Warrap. Cattle-theft raids have turned deadly, leaving more than 20 dead, and an abduction prompted MSF to suspend all activities in Yei River County. UNMISS is supporting efforts to deter further violence in Tonj East after intercommunal clashes, while the Juba Teaching Hospital director has called for more support for poor patients and a football referee shot in the head died in Juba hospital. According to UCDP, there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024.
summary.nb: Rebel- og SPLA-IO-styrker har fortsatt dødelige angrep, og drept sivile i Tonj East og Warrap-stat, inkludert 24 sivile med barn og kvinner, samt 15 sivile i et væpnet overfall i Warrap. Kvegtyveri-raider har blitt dødelige, med mer enn 20 drepte, og en bortføring førte til at MSF suspendert all aktivitet i Yei River County. UNMISS støtter tiltak for å hindre ytterligere vold i Tonj East etter lokalsamfunnskonflikter, mens direktøren ved Juba Teaching Hospital har bedt om mer støtte til fattige pasienter, og en fotballdommer som ble skutt i hodet døde på Juba sykehus. Ifølge UCDP var det 2 dødsfall i kamper i 2024.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
